**Why the model reached this decision**  
The model looks at three key pieces of information. First, your revolving‑credit utilization is about 77 % of your limit. That high balance is the strongest driver pushing the risk upward. Second, you have 14 open credit lines and loans; having many accounts also adds to the risk. Third, your monthly income of $13,333 works in the opposite direction—it helps lower the risk, but its effect is not enough to offset the two risk‑increasing factors. When the model combines these influences, it estimates a 54.8 % chance of default, which it labels “high risk.”
